DO NOT put the street address here â€” that goes in `location.building_description`. If the dec page lists 'Building #1 - Office, 1320 US Hwy 231', split it: 'Building #1 - Office' goes here, '1320 US Hwy 231' goes in `location.building_description`.

DO NOT include a building name, label, or description in this field â€” those go in `location.site_id`. If the dec page lists ONE location with no separate Premises Schedule, copy the named insured's mailing address here. If multiple locations share an address but have different building labels, repeat the address on each row.

fields.notes_for_claude: Employee Benefits Liability (EBL) Each Claim Limit. EBL is claims-made coverage â€” limits typically shown as Each Claim and Total Aggregate. Most dec pages show ONE number (the Each Claim limit, which often matches the Aggregate). If the page shows TWO values, put the Each Claim value here and emit the aggregate as the SYNTHETIC tag `policy.gl.ebl.aggregate_limit` (it has no EPIC field but our pipeline supports it as a dedicated tag).

fields.label: Location
fields.name: GLCOVERchkAppLocation
fields.notes_for_claude: TRUE if the GL General Aggregate Limit applies to Location. On the dec page or in attached endorsements, look for: (1) checkboxes labeled 'General Aggregate Limit Applies To' with Policy/Location/Project options selected; (2) form numbers like CG2503 (Designated Construction Project), CG2504 (Designated Locations), or CG2509 (Amendment of Limits of Insurance for Location); (3) endorsement names mentioning 'Designated Location'. Output 'Yes' if any indicator says this scope applies; 'No' otherwise. By default GL aggregate applies to Policy unless overridden.

fields.label: Project
fields.name: GLCOVERchkAppProject
fields.notes_for_claude: TRUE if the GL General Aggregate Limit applies to Project. On the dec page or in attached endorsements, look for: (1) checkboxes labeled 'General Aggregate Limit Applies To' with Policy/Location/Project options selected; (2) form numbers like CG2503 (Designated Construction Project), CG2504 (Designated Locations), or CG2509 (Amendment of Limits of Insurance for Project); (3) endorsement names mentioning 'Designated Project'. Output 'Yes' if any indicator says this scope applies; 'No' otherwise. By default GL aggregate applies to Policy unless overridden.

fields.label: Policy
fields.name: GLCOVERchkAppPolicy
fields.notes_for_claude: TRUE if the GL General Aggregate Limit applies to Policy. On the dec page or in attached endorsements, look for: (1) checkboxes labeled 'General Aggregate Limit Applies To' with Policy/Location/Project options selected; (2) form numbers like CG2503 (Designated Construction Project), CG2504 (Designated Locations), or CG2509 (Amendment of Limits of Insurance for Policy); (3) endorsement names mentioning 'Designated Policy'. Output 'Yes' if any indicator says this scope applies; 'No' otherwise. By default GL aggregate applies to Policy unless overridden.

fields.label: Classification
fields.name: streClassification
fields.notes_for_claude: Full text classification name from the ISO/NCCI tables. Examples: 'Carpentry', 'Contractors - Executive Supervisors', 'Apartment Buildings'. Match the dec page text exactly.

fields.label: Exposure
fields.name: streExposure
fields.notes_for_claude: The numeric exposure amount on which the GL premium is calculated. For Payroll basis this is annual payroll dollars; for Sales it's annual gross receipts; for Area it's square feet; for Each it's a headcount. Strip currency symbols and commas. If the dec page lists 'Estimated Exposure' or 'Annual Exposure', use that. Do NOT confuse with the rate (which is per-$1,000 or per-unit).

fields.label: Rate
fields.name: decePremiseOpRate
fields.notes_for_claude: Premise/Operations rate per $1,000 of exposure (or per unit). Decimal value, e.g., '6.729'. Distinct from the exposure amount.

fields.label: Products
fields.name: deceProductsRate
fields.notes_for_claude: Products/Completed-Operations rate per $1,000 of exposure. Decimal value, e.g., '4.600'.

fields.label: Premium basis
fields.name: cboPremiumBasis
fields.notes_for_claude: The unit on which the GL premium is calculated. STANDARD VALUES (use these exactly): 'Payroll', 'Sales' (or 'Gross Receipts'), 'Area' (square feet), 'Each' (per item/person), 'Units', 'Cost', 'Admissions'. Dec pages may abbreviate as a single letter (P=Payroll, S=Sales, A=Area, E=Each, U=Units, C=Cost) - translate to the full word. If the column header says 'Premium Basis', 'Rating Basis', 'Exposure Basis', or just 'Basis', that's this field. For a contractor classification (carpentry, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing) the basis is almost always Payroll. For retail/wholesale it's Sales. For real estate it's Area.

fields.label: Deductible Per Claim

fields.label: Description

EXAMPLES (not exhaustive â€” extract any endorsement-style coverage with its own limits/deductible): 'Employment Practices Liability', 'Hired/Non-Owned Auto', 'Liquor Liability', 'Pollution Liability', 'Cyber Liability', 'Stop Gap', 'Limited Pollution', 'Owners and Contractors Protective', 'Designated Construction Project Aggregate'. DO NOT include Employee Benefits Liability (EBL) here â€” EBL has its own dedicated tags under `policy.gl.ebl.*`. Match the dec page text; if abbreviated (e.g., 'EPLI'), expand to the full form.

fields.label: Code

fields.label: Limit

fields.label: Deductible Type

fields.label: Deductible

fields.label: Limit2

fields.label: Limit3

fields.label: Form Number
fields.name: streFormNumber
fields.notes_for_claude: Endorsement form number, e.g., 'WB 516 GL 02 26' or 'CG 21 47'. Match exactly including spaces/punctuation as printed.

Do NOT emit a deductible dollar amount here. If the dec page shows only a deductible for PD (not a limit), omit this field entirely.

fields.name: chkLiability1
fields.notes_for_claude:
Comma-separated string of ACORD 127 covered-auto symbols that apply to this coverage line.

ACORD 127 covered-auto symbols define which auto types a coverage applies to. Standard symbols:
  1  - Any Auto
  2  - Owned Autos Only
  3  - Owned Private Passenger Autos Only
  4  - Owned Autos Other Than Private Passenger Autos Only
  5  - Owned Autos Subject to No-Fault
  6  - Owned Autos Subject to a Compulsory Uninsured Motorists Law
  7  - Specifically Described Autos
  8  - Hired Autos Only
  9  - Non-Owned Autos Only
  19 - Mobile Equipment Subject to Compulsory or Financial Responsibility or Other Motor Vehicle Insurance Law

State-specific notes:
  - Most states (TN, KY, OH, etc.): Liability typically uses 1, 7, 8, 9. UM uses 2, 7. Comp/Coll typically use 7 (specifically described).
  - No-fault states (FL, MI, NJ, NY, PA, MA, MN, ND, KS, KY-optional, UT, HI): PIP/No-Fault coverage uses Symbol 5.
  - Some states require Symbol 6 (Compulsory UM Law) instead of 2 for Uninsured Motorists â€” read the dec page header carefully.
  - Mobile equipment (cranes, backhoes, forklifts on public roads): Symbol 19.

For this specific coverage: On the dec page, look for the 'Liability' or 'BI/PD Liability' row. Symbols typically shown as numbers in a 'Sym(s)' column or check-marks under columns labeled 1-9. For most commercial auto policies, the answer is '1, 7, 8, 9' (Any Auto + Specifically Described + Hired + Non-Owned). Output as a comma-separated string.

FORMAT: comma-separated digits, e.g., '1, 7, 8, 9' or '7'. Do NOT emit the symbol descriptions â€” just the numbers.

fields.name: chkMedical2
fields.notes_for_claude:
Comma-separated string of ACORD 127 covered-auto symbols for this coverage. See policy.auto.liability.symbols for the full symbol glossary and state-specific guidance.

For this specific coverage: Medical Payments row. Common values: '2, 7' (Owned + Specifically Described) or '2, 3, 4, 7' (varies by carrier/state). NOT applicable in PIP/no-fault states for personal-injury equivalents â€” those use no_fault.symbols=Symbol 5 instead.

FORMAT: comma-separated digits, e.g., '2, 7' or '7'.

fields.name: chkUninsured2
fields.notes_for_claude:
Comma-separated string of ACORD 127 covered-auto symbols for this coverage. See policy.auto.liability.symbols for the full symbol glossary and state-specific guidance.

For this specific coverage: Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist row. Common values: '2, 7' or '6, 7' depending on whether the state mandates Compulsory UM (Symbol 6) vs voluntary owned-autos UM (Symbol 2). Read the dec page label â€” 'Uninsured Motorists - Owned' = 2; 'Uninsured Motorists Compulsory' = 6.

FORMAT: comma-separated digits, e.g., '2, 7' or '7'.

fields.name: chkTowing3
fields.notes_for_claude:
Comma-separated string of ACORD 127 covered-auto symbols for this coverage. See policy.auto.liability.symbols for the full symbol glossary and state-specific guidance.

For this specific coverage: Towing & Labor row. Almost always Symbol 7 only (specifically described autos). If shown as 'Symbol 3' it's owned private passenger autos only.

FORMAT: comma-separated digits, e.g., '2, 7' or '7'.

fields.name: chkComprehensive2
fields.notes_for_claude:
Comma-separated string of ACORD 127 covered-auto symbols for this coverage. See policy.auto.liability.symbols for the full symbol glossary and state-specific guidance.

For this specific coverage: Comprehensive (Other Than Collision) row. Almost always Symbol 7 (specifically described autos). Some carriers add 8 for hired or use 2 for owned autos broadly.

FORMAT: comma-separated digits, e.g., '2, 7' or '7'.

fields.name: chkCauseOfLoss2
fields.notes_for_claude:
Comma-separated string of ACORD 127 covered-auto symbols for this coverage. See policy.auto.liability.symbols for the full symbol glossary and state-specific guidance.

For this specific coverage: Specified Causes of Loss row (a cheaper alternative to Comprehensive). Almost always Symbol 7. Mutually exclusive with Comprehensive on the same vehicle â€” extract whichever appears.

FORMAT: comma-separated digits, e.g., '2, 7' or '7'.

fields.name: chkCollision2
fields.notes_for_claude:
Comma-separated string of ACORD 127 covered-auto symbols for this coverage. See policy.auto.liability.symbols for the full symbol glossary and state-specific guidance.

For this specific coverage: Collision row. Almost always Symbol 7 (specifically described autos). Some policies cover hired (8) too.

FORMAT: comma-separated digits, e.g., '2, 7' or '7'.
